payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 6:1–10 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states grace is answered through endurance and paradox. Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain. as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
